Cost.Scope: All native runs, prefixes, forecasts, summaries and raw/CSV serialization in each reservation. Offline reads separate and counted. Build/tests, final report formatting and Git operations excluded. No per-decision CPU cutoff.

Meanings.F: globally remove original geometry speed preference
Meanings.G: caution margins .2/.1 ->.05/.025 and corresponding soft clearance cost, real boundary/beta unchanged
Meanings.H: replace local .8-capacity geometry penalty with known future geometry at attained offset, measured same-angle coast deceleration and full-capacity estimate
Meanings.I: weighted original score over nominal hard-feasible actions without Safe>Uncertain priority; empty ->explicit originalA fallback
Meanings.R: F plus bounded actual-force recovery feasibility, no .8 speed reserve in eligibility

Protocol.MatchedIsolation: Every main action set uses original FreeLearningController.Actions with full gas, sameH09, .2 reviews, .24 reaction, +/-35deg/90deg/s. A-H and I use identical prediction calls. R additionally probes <=4 gas roots to1.7s; this is a separate horizon/continuation treatment, not a claim about penalty removal alone.
Protocol.Recovery: Future request from predicted observation at+.8s, full reaction activation+1.04s, original grid steering closest to physical contact inversion, gas0 recovery tested with original model through1.7. Only current first request is sent. OriginalA fallback if bounded recovery set empty; no global viability claim.
Protocol.Geometry: Original Motoarena progressive-b/c and egg-asymmetric,62m straights,318.78m reference,variable curvature/width, historical35+27; no authored racing path. H extrapolation beyondH09 is explicitly heuristic, not a safety certificate.
Protocol.Scope: Same continuous native scope as142: studied bend, full62m, entire next bend and following62m; D1/H1 and corner2 cases include the third bend. Historical gate separate. Every arm starts at same constructor physical state/pending; no branch substitutions or resets.
Protocol.Pools: D0/D1 and two newS starts select isolated changes/combinations. Twelve held case/geometry pairs include original H0/H1, four new starts on both B/C, two newegg starts: EIGHT held physical families, not12 independent riders. Original H0/H1 are historically known, six held families are new. No final tuning.
Protocol.Combinations: After isolated full results select top3 nontrivially action-changing modifiers B-H by completions, paired mean legal time ratio, then changed choices. Exclude simultaneous F/H redundancy. Test all pairs and triple, then add recovery to highest-ranked pair and triple; <=6 full configurations on all selection cases. Frozen selection only, not held.
Protocol.Confirmation: Before opening held worlds, lock top3 nonA variants across singles/combinations by reliability then mean paired time ratio. Run each plusA on all12 held pairs. Family-weighted improvements prevent width duplicates inflating evidence. Orientational GO>=5% mean paired family time gain with no newDNF; report smaller gains and all failures asPARTIAL, no threshold fitting.
Protocol.Diagnostics: Up to3 beta45 native failures from distinct case/objective histories continued with unchanged controller and ONLY native threshold60 or omitted. Other physical guards retained. Up to2 native uncertified stops repeated with original refined sweep certificate. Auxiliary detector tests never promote main results or prove real-motorcycle validity.
Protocol.Budget: 160 new worlds maximum,1800CPU-s maximum; planned40isolated+<=24combinations+48held+<=8detector diagnostics+6warm repeats=126. Full autonomous held runs take precedence; optional repeats omitted near total budget. Never stop because one decision exceeds.2CPU-s. Cold and subsequent decisions reported separately.

Preflight.Meaning: Full comparable native worlds, original142 fingerprint/time parity and numerical/queue guards. Behavioral DNF is evidence, not a pipeline failure.

CombinationLock.Rule: Reliability, paired mean completed time ratio, changed decisions; no held input.

RecoveryCombinationLock.Rule: Best completed combination and the maximal compatible triple; physical continuation treatment kept distinct.

CombinationExtension.Reason: Global direction/yaw removal each failed0/4. Test whether physical continuation can replace some stabilizing role, rather than declaring the old penalties necessary from those failures.

OriginalRecoveryCombinationLock.Rule: Best completed combination and the maximal compatible triple; physical continuation treatment kept distinct.

CombinationExtension.FallbackCaveat: R may explicitly fall back to originalA when bounded recovery cannot certify a root. This is a combined consequence/fallback controller, not proof that the removed penalty is absent from every actual fallback choice.

ConfirmationLock.Rule: Original frozen143 reliability/paired-time/changed-choice ranking for top3, plus the prospectively registered mandatory global-B comparator. No held result is used.

Analysis143.Limits: Deterministic finite cases,8physical held families in12 case/geometry pairs.5percent is an orientational target; smaller or mixed effects are explicit. No population or empirical motorcycle claim.

Packaging.Meaning: All decision arrays moved losslessly to decision-logs.json.gz. Every native row, result, configuration, source hash and lock retained; no simulation or selection rerun.
